acceptanceCriteria: Every compiled route of the supported router dialects resolves its handler; a resource declaration generating a create route for a controller with no create action is reported with the declaration line, the resolved handler and the missing action.
Actions defined in a parent class or an included module/concern are not reported; only:/except: restrictions that remove the route are honoured.

Unresolvable handlers or dynamic definitions abstain with a named reason rather than report; requirements in application-map-v0.md; focused tests via heavy.sh; dogfood CEM; build-log entry; Closes #1174.
body: GitHub #1174. Route declarations (including resource-style generated routes) can name actions no controller/handler implements; requests 500 instead of 404/405. Requested: for every route the application map compiles from supported router dialects, resolve the handler and report routes whose action is not defined on it, including through inheritance and concerns/modules, honouring only:/except:.
title: GH #1174: source check: routes whose resolved handler does not define the action (ROUTE-ACTION-MISSING)
